links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified Spanish patient education materials on childhood glaucoma
links.outcome: Readability (INFLESZ score) of Spanish patient education materials, with expert-rated quality (helpfulness, truthfulness, harmlessness) as a safety check
links.effect: Mean INFLESZ rose from 56.6 ± 4.9 (8th-grade level) to 69.6 ± 2.3 (4th- to 6th-grade level), P < .001. Revised materials had fewer syllables, words and complex words, with no significant difference in sentence count. Quality was unchanged (median 15 in both groups, P = .74).
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o can be used as a supplemental tool by health care professionals to improve the readability of existing Spanish PEMs on childhood glaucoma, without sacrificing the quality, accuracy, or reliability of their content.

design_hint: reading-level constraint in prompt with clinician quality review
